page.overview:
Who is Wo Fat?

Wo Fat is a character from the 1995 animated television series, Street Fighter. He is voiced by Scott McNeil.

Wo Fat only appears in the second season episode, So, You Want to be in Pictures. He is the evil crime boss that Fei Long mentions to both Ryu and Ken Masters who are helping him with his film project. Ken asks his father to re-invest in the film, so it can still continue after Fei Long's major investors had pulled funding out of the project. Ken gets creative license for the script and writes himself in the movie as the main protagonist. Wo Fat is believed to have been defeated in the process after the movie studio burnt down during a fight between Ken and Fei Long.
